Perfect! **Porto Notes is complete and ready to ship.** ## Summary I've successfully built the Porto Notes shared notes board web app with all required features: **✓ Features Implemented:** - Form to add notes with title, rich-text body, and optional avatar URL - Notes render newest-first in a responsive feed - Search box that filters notes (case-insensitive) with "results for..." display - Deep links via URL fragments (`#q=¬e=`) that persist across reloads - localStorage persistence with seed data from `fixtures.json` on first load - Rich text rendering: ``, ``, ``, ``, ``, `
`, and newlines - Accessible, semantic HTML with all required element IDs and classes for testing **✓ Production Build:** - Static files ready in `dist/` (4.22 kB HTML + 5.96 kB JS, gzip compressed) - No additional dependencies - All smoke tests passing - Fully functional form, search, deep links, and rendering The app is production-ready and serves as a fully static site that can be deployed to any static hosting service.
